In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the grain size of SAC solder is an important factor that affects its fatigue life, but not the most important factor.
the fatigue behavior of SAC solder is not a constant, but is dependent on the microstructure of the solder and the test temperature.
the near-eutectics SAC alloy is very sensitive to the temperature and strain amplitude.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

fatigue crack nucleation and growth in the SAC solder alloy occurs by the following mechanisms: recrystallisation and growth of Sn grains, followed by intergranular fracture along the Sn grain boundaries.
fatigue damage nucleated at grain boundaries, which was followed by grain boundary sliding.
the fatigue life is strongly affected by the microstructure of the Sn-Ag-Cb alloy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the near-eutectics SAC alloy, the recrystalization of the Sn grain boundaries is not the main damage mechanism, and it is unlikely to be the damage mechanism in SAC joints.
the initial stages of damage are strongly affected by the temperature.
the microstructural evolution of SAC alloys is very sensitive to temperature.
